name: Mercenary Crippling Net
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Crippling Net (players/gladiator/mercenary/net_merc.sval, 14 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 6 (in brackets): damage taken +50% (+100%); cooldown 0.2 s (0.4 s); mana 30 (24). Its own mana 30 (24), cooldown 0.2 s (0.4 s). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon. Numbers are HoH1's, not this port's.
summary: The net disarms and slows by 80% for 3 s; netted enemies take 50% more damage. Faster to throw again (0.2 s), costs 30 mana.
